comment_regular: PlayerCharacter post-shot AMMO-consumption override. Takes only PlayerCharacter *this and independently queries GetEquippedAmmoData(1); it does not receive WEAP EntryData in EDI. God mode (g_godModeEnabled at 0x00B3BB06) skips the transaction. Otherwise it decrements/removes exactly one equipped AMMO item. Base Actor slot +0x2E8 is the shared no-op at 0x0060D0A0.
